name: Devon Allen
story: Women in Spatial + Survey’s committee biography describes Devon Allen’s surveying degree, cadastral and engineering survey work, and resource-consent practice at Cheal in Taupō. It also records her interest in encouraging young surveyors and her participation in early-career professional networks. The biography is undated, so its employment and committee details are treated as a snapshot.

Committee biographies connect the network to different career stages: Amy Tay’s transport and infrastructure consulting, FME and 3D modelling; Georgia Goodsell’s spatial-intelligence work and support for new entrants; Devon Allen’s cadastral and engineering surveying; and student representative Malindi Reihana-Ruka’s interest in working with her community and encouraging other women into the field. The biographies are not date-stamped, so they do not establish current employment or study status. A 2024 recap records lightning talks on tactile mapping, surveying, GIS in schools and data collection.
